description: This file declares interfaces related to a dispatcher thread for GStreamer within the Rialto server component. It includes factory and thread interface classes, with methods for creation and thread management, and references external GStreamer and Rialto-specific classes.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating GStreamer dispatcher thread instances.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Interface representing a dispatcher thread for GStreamer operations.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Creates a new GStreamer dispatcher thread with specified client and pipeline.
